purpose: Read only the app-private evidence left by the one terminal failed CP2 Android attempt. The host runner failed only because the concrete AndroidSurface subclass string did not equal the planned PGraphicsAndroid2D base string; this recovery may collect host-side PNG evidence but cannot change the original attempt status or create Android support acceptance.
required_checks: every original report input SHA is still current before ADB access
AndroidSurface source declares the concrete class as extending planned PGraphicsAndroid2D base
original native terminal result is passed/event result/API33/sequence8 with seven compositions, eight completed frames, finite quiet delay at least 300ms, and the original nonce
read private result before and after all pulls and require exact JSON equality with original native result
require the application process to be absent before and after recovery; a running process makes the preserved evidence ambiguous
read private frame-1 through frame-7 JSON and require exact JSON equality with original report frames; verify frame-8 absence as a confirmed missing file rather than an ADB transport error
read current emulator API/fingerprint and require equality with original report

pull raw private result/frame JSON and frame/saved PNG bytes only into new recovery output; preserve raw JSON bytes while separately checking parsed equality with the original journal, then use existing image_record and check_frames host checks
attempt an installed APK SHA through pm path/sha256sum; if available it must equal the original report's APK SHA, while unavailable access is recorded without fabrication
forbidden_actions: modify original failed report or attempt
failure_policy: Any precondition, ADB, private-journal, image, fingerprint, or deadline failure writes only the separate recovery report. It leaves the original attempt terminal failed and does not authorize retry.
